content.value: You are designing a LFR using AVR microcontroller. The robot needs to store its calibration settings (such as sensor thresholds and motor speeds) in EEPROM so that these settings are retained even after the robot is power off. (i) Write a code to save the sensor threshold value and motor speed value to EEPROM. (ii) Write a code to read the saved sensor threshold value and motor speed value from EEPROM and use them to initialize the robot settings.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
